questions: I feel most like myself when I'm around other people.
I often take the lead in group situations without being asked.
After a long social event, I need time alone to feel like myself again.
I would rather spend years perfecting one craft than spread my energy across many interests.
I tend to prepare thoroughly before starting something new.
I lose interest in a project once the hardest problem is solved.
When something goes wrong, my first instinct is to do something about it rather than sit with the feeling.
I find it easy to stay calm when the people around me are stressed.
I tend to take criticism personally, even when I know it isn't meant that way.
I find comfort in a predictable daily routine.
I'm drawn to situations where the outcome isn't guaranteed.
I often seek out experiences that most people in my life would consider unusual.
I often think through problems by talking or writing rather than sitting in silence.
I notice details in my environment that other people seem to walk past.
I prefer finding a reliable method and sticking to it over experimenting with new approaches.
